name: Jewish-Medieval Heritage of Erfurt
description: In the medieval heart of Erfurt, the capital of Thuringia, three buildings preserve the story of a Jewish community that lived alongside its Christian neighbours from the late 11th to the mid-14th century. They include the Old Synagogue, described as the oldest in Europe, a ritual bath (mikveh) that was only rediscovered in 2007, and the 13th-century Stone House, a rare surviving medieval home.
